summary: sixbails 1.1.0 static keyword co-occurrence with no traced installer harm
details: Package lib/Utils/generics.js contains the substring 'ping' at line 403 and 'GET' tokens at lines 194 and 238. These are keyword co-occurrences typical of HTTP client and utility code and are not, on their own, evidence of a command execution or exfiltration path. No install-time or import-time network beacon, no read of installer credentials or environment, no fetch-and-execute of remote content, and no hardcoded attacker-controlled destination are visible in the available evidence. The package name closely resembles other WhatsApp / Baileys-family libraries; the code layout under lib/Utils is consistent with that family, but this alone does not establish malicious behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
